messages:
maya: Weekly capacity heatmap for clusters attached. Thinking we need a 15% buffer in us-west and 10% in eu-central for next week's marketing surge. Thoughts? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

oliver: can you paste the key numbers? I don't have the image right now.

maya: sure, pasting the high-level table here:
```
Region    Cluster         AllocGPU  UsedGPU  BufferReq  ProjectedHours
us-west   burst-pool-1    512       430      15%        240k
eu-central main-pool      320       290      10%        160k
ap-south  spot-pool       128       115      5%         90k
```

zain: looks reasonable. note that main-pool eu had node provisioning lag ~12m avg over last 24h. can we pre-warm 2 nodes to avoid cold starts? :eyes:

maya: yes. leah — can you raise a pre-warm ticket for eu-central main-pool (2 x A100 equiv) and bump autoscale min by +2 for Monday 03:00 UTC?

leah: on it. ETA to provision ~45m once order hits cloud. i'll also add the schedule tag and bump autoscale config:
```
/infra/tags: schedule=marketing-boost
autoscale.min += 2
```

infra-bot: Capacity alert: us-west burst-pool-1 reported 4 nodes with KV cache miss rate >20% in the last hour. Investigating.

oliver: high KV miss -> higher token compute. any quick mitigations? can we enable prefix caching on the busy routes?

zain: yep. enable prefix caching for /api/generate and /api/chat for the next 6 hours. maya — ok to toggle?

maya: ok toggling now. will monitor SLOs. :thumbsup:

leah: pre-warm ticket created - INC-2026-0334. Provision scheduled Mon 02:15 UTC (reserving earlier window to account for cloud lag). cost tag set for chargeback.

zain: also flagging potential network egress cap in ap-south next weekend due to provider maintenance — recommend throttling heavy embedding batches and shifting them to eu-central where feasible.

maya: good call. i'll add a runbook note and update routing policy to favor eu-central for embedding batch jobs 2026-03-21 to 2026-03-23.

oliver: all good from infra side. i'll update the capacity dashboard and ping #product with the heatmap/notes.
